#summary Overview of AmFast remoting features.

= Remoting =
 * ChannelSet objects route request messages and dispatch response messages.
 * Each ChannelSet contains a ServiceMapper which maps [Target] objects to destinations.
 * Each ChannelSet contains one or more [Channel] objects. [Channel]s handle the technical details of sending and receiving messages.
 * A ChannelSet's ServiceMapper determines how to process a [Message] when a [Message] is received by a [Channel].

== Example ==
{{{
import amfast.remoting as remoting
from amfast.remoting import channel
from amfast.remoting.wsgi_channel import WsgiChannel

# This method will be exposed to remote invocation.
def remote_method(arg1, arg2):
    print "%s:%s" % (arg1, arg2)

# A CallableTarget contains a callable
# that gets invoked when a request message
# is received.
target = remoting.CallableTarget('exposed_method', remote_method)

# A Service object is a collection of Targets.
service = remoting.Service('exposed_service')

# Add a target to a service.
service.mapTarget(target)

# A ServiceMapper object keeps track
# of all exposed services and targets.
service_mapper = remoting.ServiceMapper()

# Expose a service.
# This service can be accessed from a client
# with a RemoteObject request to 'exposed_service.exposed_method'
service_mapper.mapService(service)

# A ChannelSet uses a ServiceMapper to determine
# how to process RPC messages that were received
# from a channel.
channel_set = channel.ChannelSet(service_mapper=service_mapper)

# Each ChannelSet contains one or more Channels
# which handle the actual receiving and sending of messages.
# AmFast includes built-in channels for CherryPy,
# Twisted Web, and WSGI.
wsgi_app = WsgiChannel('rpc-channel')
channel_set.mapChannel(wsgi_app)
}}}
